paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: DarkSide-50 sets 90% C.L. limits on the axioelectric coupling g_Ae for ALP DM absorption, with stronger direct-detection limits for masses between 0.03 keV/c2 (30 eV) and 0.2 keV/c2 (200 eV). The paper also constrains DM-electron cross section, dark photon kinetic mixing kappa, and sterile neutrino mixing |Ue4|^2. Numerical g_Ae values are only presented graphically in Fig. 2; no data table is provided, so no numerical (mass, coupling) points are extractable. Local DM density assumed 0.3 GeV/cm^3, escape velocity 544 km/s, v0=238 km/s. Coupling type AxionElectron is clear from text but data not extractable. | Vision: Traced the red solid DarkSide-50 (2022) curve on the g_Ae vs m_A axion-like-particle plot (middle-left panel). X-axis is m_A in keV/c^2 (converted to eV), y-axis is dimensionless g_Ae from ~1e-14 to ~1e-11. The provided MeV/1e-40 calibration applies to the top-left cross-section panel, not this axion panel; axes for the traced plot were read directly. A sharp drop/kink occurs around 0.25 keV and another feature near 3 keV. | Calibration: No calibration needed
